title: Show a message when an e-document file cannot be viewed or no data could be extracted
summary: E-document import handling now displays user-friendly messages when a PDF file cannot be displayed or no data was extracted, instead of throwing runtime errors.
key_points: Added guards to prevent runtime errors when viewing corrupted PDF files
Shows clear message when extracted data is unavailable
Improves user experience for invalid or corrupt e-document files
quote: This adds small guards so both actions show a clear message when there is nothing to display or the file cannot be read.
